model_identity.name: DeepCrack Multi-Scale Feature-Fused Convolutional Neural Network
model_identity.source_citation: Liu et al., 'DeepCrack: A Deep Hierarchical Feature Learning Architecture for Crack Segmentation', IEEE T-ITS

metric_definitions.pixel_accuracy: (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN) - Ratio of correctly predicted crack & non-crack pixels
metric_definitions.pixel_precision: TP / (TP + FP) - Ratio of predicted crack pixels that are authentic cracks
metric_definitions.pixel_recall_sensitivity: TP / (TP + FN) - Ratio of ground-truth crack pixels detected
metric_definitions.specificity: TN / (TN + FP) - Ratio of background pixels correctly rejected
metric_definitions.pixel_f1_dice: 2*TP / (2*TP + FP + FN) - Harmonic mean of precision and recall
metric_definitions.pixel_iou_jaccard: TP / (TP + FP + FN) - Intersection over union of crack areas
